extracted.stage: Pre-grant; inheritance tax due before grant of probate can issue
extracted.summary: A solicitor administering a £526,000 Guildford estate, mostly illiquid property, asks to borrow £73,000 to pay inheritance tax due by 9 October so the grant can issue.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding the inheritance tax liability on this estate. We have noted the gross estate value of approximately £526,000, the £73,000 requested, and the 9 October tax deadline. To take this further we would need confirmation of the executors' details and their consent, a copy of the will and the draft IHT account, details of the property and any existing charges or other estate liabilities, and confirmation of your firm's involvement in the administration. Once we have those documents a member of our team will review the enquiry and come back to you.
